read: list-email-thread-filings {} returns {filings} for the authenticated partner. The app shows only subject and sender_name (null shows as unavailable), never summary, addresses or ids. activity_version is the server guard and is null for legacy events; never infer missing fields.

read_fields.event_id: Filing event UUID, supplied to undo
read_fields.subject: Source email subject, null when unavailable
read_fields.sender_name: Source email sender display name, null when unavailable
read_fields.occurred_at: Source email timestamp; falls back to filing time when intake did not pass the email time
read_fields.activity_version: Activity version recorded at filing, null for legacy events

undo: undo-email-thread-filing {event_id,idempotency_key} with a new UUID key per attempt. Refusals such as email_thread_filing_changed leave the filing intact and are shown, never retried.
deployment_order: The app must not merge before the producer PR is deployed.
